name: Adaptive Volumetric Clipping by CSG Culling
definition: CSG Culling: Uses a virtual CSG probe (e.g., implicit signed distance function) to introduce hierarchical inside-outside culling tests during tree traversal, allowing dynamic clipping of Shell and Solid.
summary: Adaptive Volumetric Clipping by CSG Culling is a hierarchical technique that projects Gaussian splats to a virtual CSG probe surface to eliminate popping artifacts, distinguishing itself by modifying splat positions rather than just estimating error.
